prompt:
Our investment research team needs a daily gold market briefing for today, July 8, 2025. We have raw price feed dumps and analyst notes sitting in the market_data/commodities/gold/ directory, but nobody has turned them into a proper client-facing report yet.

Please generate the gold daily report as a file named `gold_daily_report.md`. It should cover both international (USD) and domestic (CNY) gold prices with today's movement, include a brief look at recent price trends, summarize the key market-moving factors from today's analyst notes, and give tiered investment guidance for different types of investors.

The report will be sent to clients, so it needs to be complete, professional, and include an appropriate disclaimer.
